text: So Alex, the humpback whale migration is winding down along the South East Queensland coast, and spotters reckon this has been one of the best calf seasons in years. speaker: charlie
text: Love that, it's basically Queensland's version of a footy grand final, except the players weigh forty tonnes and don't need a video ref. Meanwhile down on the sand, the next shift is clocking on, our turtles are back for nesting season.

text: Exactly, loggerheads and flatbacks are hauling themselves up Queensland beaches right now to lay their eggs as spring kicks off.
